license_required.quote: practice professional nursing as defined by the Nursing Practice Act unless exempted or duly licensed to do so pursuant to the provisions of that act

degree_required.quote: the applicant has successfully completed an approved program of nursing for licensure as a registered nurse and has graduated or is eligible for graduation

accrediting_body.quote: shall prescribe standards and approve curricula for educational programs preparing persons for licensure under the Nursing Practice Act

exams.name: National licensing examination for registered nurses (NCLEX-RN)
exams.notes: Required for licensure by examination; may be waived for expedited licensure from another jurisdiction
exams.quote: Applicants for licensure by examination shall be required to pass the national licensing examination for registered nurses.

exams.name: National licensing examination for licensed practical nurses (NCLEX-PN)
exams.notes: Required for LPN licensure by examination
exams.quote: Applicants for licensure by examination shall be required to pass the national licensing examination for licensed practical nurses.

interval_years.quote: shall renew the license every two years by the end of the applicant's renewal month

required.quote: shall show proof of continuing education as required by the board

period_years.quote: shall renew the license every two years by the end of the applicant's renewal month and shall show proof of continuing education as required by the board

available.quote: The board shall issue an expedited license to practice professional registered nursing without an examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed in another licensing jurisdiction and holds a valid, unrestricted license and is in good standing with the licensing board in that licensing jurisdiction.

requirements.value: Must hold a valid, unrestricted license in good standing in another licensing jurisdiction; board expedites issuance within 30 days; if prior jurisdiction did not require examination, board may require exam before renewal; applicants from territories or foreign countries must demonstrate English proficiency.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue an expedited license to practice professional registered nursing without an examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed in another licensing jurisdiction and holds a valid, unrestricted license and is in good standing with the licensing board in that licensing jurisdiction. The board shall expedite the issuance of a license in accordance with Section 61-1-31.1 NMSA 1978 within thirty days.

regulatory_model.quote: practice professional nursing as defined by the Nursing Practice Act unless exempted or duly licensed to do so pursuant to the provisions of that act

credential_type.quote: shall provide for the examination, licensing and renewal of licenses of applicants

is_mandatory.quote: Except as otherwise provided in the Nursing Practice Act, unless licensed as a registered nurse under the Nursing Practice Act, no person shall: (1) practice professional nursing

title_protection.quote: no person shall use the title "nurse" unless the person is licensed or has been licensed in the past as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse under the Nursing Practice Act

scope_protection.quote: Except as otherwise provided in the Nursing Practice Act, unless licensed as a registered nurse under the Nursing Practice Act, no person shall: (1) practice professional nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license or certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license or certificate of registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or incompetent to practice nursing
Addiction to the use of habit-forming substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is addicted to the use of habit-forming substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by the rules adopted by the board pursuant to the Nursing Practice Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly violated any provision of the Nursing Practice Act or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has willfully or repeatedly violated any provisions of the Nursing Practice Act, including any rule adopted by the board pursuant to that act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subject to disciplinary action in another jurisdiction for acts similar to those described in the disciplinary grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: was licensed to practice nursing in any jurisdiction, territory or possession of the United States or another country and was the subject of disciplinary action as a licensee for acts similar to acts described in this subsection

disciplinary_grounds.description: Uses conversion therapy on a minor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: uses conversion therapy on a minor

definition_quote.value: assisting individuals, families or communities in maintaining or attaining optimal health, assessing and implementing a plan of care to accomplish defined goals and evaluating responses to care and treatment. This practice is based on specialized knowledge, judgment and nursing skills acquired through educational preparation in nursing and in the biological, physical, social and behavioral sciences
definition_quote.quote: "practice of nursing" means assisting individuals, families or communities in maintaining or attaining optimal health, assessing and implementing a plan of care to accomplish defined goals and evaluating responses to care and treatment.

value: promoting and supporting optimal human functions and responses
establishing an environment conducive to well-being or to the support of a dignified death
collaborating on the health care regimen
administering medications and performing treatments prescribed by a person authorized to prescribe
recording and reporting nursing observations, assessments, interventions and responses to health care
maintaining accountability for safe and effective nursing care
methods_authorized.quote: initiating and maintaining comfort measures; promoting and supporting optimal human functions and responses; establishing an environment conducive to well-being or to the support of a dignified death; collaborating on the health care regimen; administering medications and performing treatments prescribed by a person authorized in this state or in any other state in the United States to prescribe them

drug_authority.value: Nurses may administer medications and perform treatments as prescribed; certified nurse practitioners and clinical nurse specialists may prescribe and distribute dangerous drugs and controlled substances Schedules II-V; CRNAs may prescribe and administer dangerous drugs and controlled substances Schedules II-V within anesthesia practice environments
drug_authority.quote: administering medications and performing treatments prescribed by a person authorized in this state or in any other state in the United States to prescribe them

license_tiers.quote: advanced practice registered nurse means a certified nurse practitioner, certified registered nurse anesthetist or certified clinical nurse specialist licensed pursuant to the Nursing Practice Act

aprn_role_categories.quote: "advanced practice" means the practice of professional registered nursing by a registered nurse who has been prepared through additional formal education...including certified nurse practitioners, certified registered nurse anesthetists and certified clinical nurse specialists

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "licensed practical nursing" means the practice of a directed scope of nursing requiring basic knowledge of the biological, physical, social and behavioral sciences and nursing procedures, which practice is at the direction of a registered nurse, physician or dentist licensed to practice in this state.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: shall promulgate rules establishing standards for authorizing prescriptive authority to certified nurse practitioners, certified clinical nurse specialists and certified registered nurse anesthetists

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: prescription and distribution of dangerous drugs and controlled substances included in Schedules II through V of the Controlled Substances Act

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: A statewide program for certification of medication aides and approval of medication aide training programs is created under the board.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: delegating and supervising nursing interventions that may be performed safely by others and are not in conflict with the Nursing Practice Act

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: A health care facility shall not retaliate against, demote, suspend, terminate, discipline, discriminate against or report any action to the board of nursing when a nurse makes a good faith request for safe harbor.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is entered into law and entered into with all other jurisdictions legally joining therein

multistate_license_option_available.quote: shall provide a nurse applying for a first-time license, or upon renewal of a license, the option for a single or multistate license, which may incur an additional fee

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The board shall establish an alternative to discipline program to rehabilitate nurses whose competencies may be impaired because of the use of habit-forming substances so that nurses can be treated and returned to or continue the practice of nursing

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: Certified registered nurse anesthetists shall function in either an independent role or in collaboration with other health care providers in accordance with the policies of a health care facility.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: The board shall adopt rules concerning a prescriptive authority formulary for certified registered nurse anesthetists that shall be based on the scope of practice of certified registered nurse anesthetists.
